description: This file defines the ConfigField class, which is a UI component for editing configuration fields in the application. It extends BaseConfigField and manages a JTextField UI element, listens for messages to update its value, and provides static methods to retrieve field values from ConfigurationImage instances.

classes.name: ConfigField
classes.description: A UI component class for displaying and editing configuration fields, incorporating message listening and value parsing logic.

methods.name: ConfigField
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the UI component, registers message listeners, and sets up key event handling.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the displayed value in the text field.

methods.name: loadValue
methods.description: Loads and displays the value from a ConfigurationImage object.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Static method to retrieve a numeric value from a ConfigurationImage for a given Field.

methods.name: getFloatValue
methods.description: Static method to retrieve a float value with precision restoration from a ConfigurationImage and Field.

methods.name: getIntValue
methods.description: Static method to retrieve an integer value from a ConfigurationImage and Field.
